AboutMeHero.title: I build scalable information systems, robust backend architectures, and fullstack apps.
AboutMeHero.description: IT Engineering student at ESIR specializing in Information Systems. My background bridges a rigorous scientific foundation with expertise in software architecture, fullstack development, and data engineering. From my internship at Vitré Hospital to building AI-driven platforms, I am dedicated to creating robust and scalable solutions for complex challenges.

blog.title: My Year in Chicoutimi
blog.description: Below is a list of posts I've written about my exchange year at the University of Quebec in Chicoutimi (UQAC). This blog is mostly intended to keep a record and chronology of my experiences, but I hope it can also be useful to other students considering an exchange in Canada! Feel free to reach out if you have any questions about UQAC or life in Chicoutimi.
